messages:
Ivy: Quick heads-up 1: my niece Milo (2yo) is popping in at 3:30 for a short visit. They'll have a folded double stroller and will need a temp badge + a quiet spot or nursing room if available. Also unrelated: a courier said a giant inflatable T-Rex prop for Friday's party might arrive ~3:15. Can reception accept an oversized soft package and someone deflate/store it? :baby::t_rex:
Front Desk: We can accept both. Please DM full name and phone for the visitor badge. Nursing room availability depends on bookings 1449 checking now. For oversized packages we typically accept at reception and Facilities can move to temporary storage.
Ivy: Visitor name: Maya Reed, phone 555-9090. Visit should be ~20-30 minutes. Stroller folds but may be bulky. T-Rex box labelled "EVENT - T-REX INFLATABLE" per courier.
Courier-Bot: Delivery logged at 15:03 for 1 oversized soft package to "EVENT - T-REX INFLATABLE". Handling: fragile-ish (sewn seams), bulky. ETA 15:16. Recommended action: reception hold and Facilities relocate to events locker.
Front Desk: Nursing room check: 3pm slot free until 4pm. We can reserve for 3:25-3:50. We'll pre-print a temp badge. Also note: stroller parking by coat rack (folded only) or we can put it behind Reception bench for short stay.
Facilities: We can deflate and fold the inflatable if needed and store in the events locker (locker key required). Suggest bringing a soft rolling cart to avoid scuffing. Note: if it's helium-filled on arrival, no open flames near it and Security needs to sign off.
Security: If parcel contains compressed gas (helium), driver must show SDS or indicate contents. Building policy forbids leaving filled helium tanks unattended in public areas. If it's just the costume without tanks, we're fine.
Ava: I can meet Maya in the lobby at 3:25 and escort to the nursing room. Also happy to take the inflatable to the events locker at 3:20 once reception signs for it.
Front Desk: Badge will print as:
```
Visitor: Maya Reed
Company: Guest
Badge: TEMP-MAYA-330
Notes: Visiting with toddler Milo (stroller folded). Nursing room reserved 15:25-15:50. Inflatable delivery arriving ~15:16 for events - reception to hold.
```
Front Desk: We'll leave a small laminated sign by the nursing room "Reserved for visitor 15:25-15:50" and place a soft runner from door to bench. If stroller can't fit behind reception, we'll use the coat alcove.
Ivy: Amazing 1 thanks so much. Courier said no tanks, just the deflated costume packed loose, but I'll double-check and update if that changes.
Ava: If it turns out to be filled we should ask driver to deflate and we can inspect seams before storing. I'll bring gloves and a cart.
Security: Thanks for flagging 1 appreciate the heads-up. If driver claims tanks are present, hold delivery and call Security before signing.
Front Desk: All set 1 badge printed and in tray. We'll message again if the courier shows earlier.
Ivy: You're all the best 1 Milo is very excited about dinosaurs. I'll bring mini cookies as bribe for the nursing room silence :grimacing:
